tagline: A 4,000-person village that swells to 80,000 visitors a day in summer, choking a single coast road — while a 15-minute boat across the bay sits half-used. The water is the answer.
summary: Saint-Tropez is one of the Mediterranean's most concentrated luxury destinations: a village of roughly 4,000 permanent residents that absorbs more than 80,000 visitors a day in July and August. That surge overwhelms the single D98 coast road, where a short drive can take hours in peak-season gridlock. Meanwhile the Gulf of Saint-Tropez is crossed by the Bateaux Verts shuttle network, which links the town to Sainte-Maxime in about 15 minutes by sea — a fraction of the road time. With a packed superyacht harbour, marquee events like Les Voiles de Saint-Tropez, and a town actively pushing sustainable mobility to relieve its summer congestion, Saint-Tropez is a textbook case for a fast, clean foiling network that moves people across the bay and down the coast instead of around it.

use_cases.title: Cross-bay foiling shuttle
use_cases.body: Upgrade the busy Gulf of Saint-Tropez ferry with a fast, near-silent all-electric foiling service between the town, Sainte-Maxime, Port Grimaud and Les Issambres. It carries the dense cross-bay flow in minutes while the D98 sits gridlocked.

use_cases.title: Superyacht & resort guest transfers
use_cases.body: On-demand foiling transfers move owners and guests between the Saint-Tropez harbour, anchored superyachts and the peninsula's villas and beach clubs. A smooth, zero-wake arrival that fits the destination and skips the summer traffic entirely.

use_cases.title: Riviera coastal line
use_cases.body: A foiling line connecting Saint-Tropez with Cannes, Nice and the wider Côte d'Azur, with the hybrid platform covering the longer open-water legs. Visitors reach the marquee Riviera destinations by sea instead of crawling around the coast by road.

journeys.today: A ~15-minute Bateaux Verts diesel ferry across the bay, or a drive of well over an hour around the gulf in peak-season traffic.
journeys.with_navier: A fast, near-silent foiling crossing of the bay that runs cleanly and reliably through the busy summer season.

journeys.today: A long coastal drive of two-plus hours in summer, or a seasonal sea excursion.
journeys.with_navier: A fast foiling line across the bay between the two marquee Riviera destinations.

journeys.today: A seasonal-only Trans Côte d'Azur ferry of roughly two and a half hours, or a long drive around the coast.
journeys.with_navier: A fast year-round foiling line up the Riviera to the gateway airport, on the hybrid platform for the full distance.

journeys.today: A flight or a long conventional ferry via Nice or Toulon.
journeys.with_navier: A premium experiential foiling cruise across open water on the long-range hybrid, with no charging dependency mid-passage.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: The dense, defining Saint-Tropez flow — the cross-bay shuttle to Sainte-Maxime (~3 nm), Port Grimaud and Les Issambres — sits far inside the 70 nm all-electric envelope on protected gulf water, ideal for very high-frequency rotations that relieve the D98 in peak season. Quiet, zero-wake foiling fits the town's sustainable-mobility push.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: The 2,000 nm hybrid range opens the longer coastal corridors beyond the electric envelope — up the Riviera to Cannes (~32 nm) and Nice (~50 nm) and across open water to Corsica (~110 nm) — as premium experiential cruises with no charging dependency.
